description.value: A managed recreation campground along Chilliwack Lake Road with sites either beside the river or tucked in forest, each with a picnic table and firepit; pack-in/pack-out required, gates lock at 10 pm, and the FSR approach adds some load to a loaded bike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thurston.campchilliwackvalley.ca is live and active for 2026, confirming the campground is open; phone and email in OSM match the website exactly, and the physical address (53425 Chilliwack Lake Road, Rosedale, BC) appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags. Online reservations are explicitly supported via the website's booking system and detailed cancellation policy in the FAQ. No amenities specific to cyclists (hiker/biker sites, showers, device charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the FAQ explicitly states no public WiFi and no garbage service, consistent with a remote wilderness setting.
concerns: Thurston Meadows Group Site is temporarily unavailable due to weather damage from fall 2025; individual and double sites remain bookable.
Physical address (53425 Chilliwack Lake Road, Rosedale, BC) is present on the website but absent from OSM tags — OSM address field should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active tent-capable campground along the Chilliwack Lake Road corridor with online reservations; a legitimate overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Chilliwack Valley area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pack-in, pack-out campground with no garbage service and no public WiFi. Site office has an emergency landline only. Website notes cellular coverage and services are approximately a 10-minute drive away in Chilliwack.

wow_evidence: sites either beside the river or tucked in forest, each with a picnic table and firepit
